blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte said on Friday that she was preparing for the worst as she awaited the verdict of the Senate impeachment court, warning of the consequences of her possible conviction, including the displacement of Office of the Vice President (OVP) employees. While the Senate has yet to set a definite date for the conclusion of the trial, Batangas Rep. Gerville Luistro, a member of the House prosecution panel, earlier expressed hope that proceedings would end on Dec. 18, the last session day of Congress before its holiday break.
